policy: No-regression ceilings based on the lazy-feature and lazy-locale production build. Increases require an explicit performance review. PdfViewer raised 500000 -> 510000 for the pdfjs-dist 6.3.289 security upgrade (GHSA-hq66-cqwq-w95j). Total CSS raised 140000 -> 160000 for the desktop shell theme layer (tinted desk, floating window, sidebar rail, content tiles and list rows), which adds ~16 kB of hand-written CSS so the shell derives every surface from the existing app-* tokens and keeps user themes intact.
